supplementaryEvidence.supports: HE payment, forced use of available original discarded Slashes with distance but no count limit; delegated current item does not convert the source; delegated Yang cannot discard the source-fee suit.
supplementaryEvidence.caveat: One example omits the negative word for the source-fee suit. Its explanation and later summary both forbid that suit; implementation follows the consistent explanation, not the contradictory example.

interpretations.rule: Actual phase and all real discard causes
interpretations.basis: Current primary says 本阶段弃置过的花色, without limiting it to this skill.
interpretations.implementation: A capability-gated capture records scalar immutable actual-phase token, owned source, original card, exact native discard movement sequence and suit for every classified actual discard, including another skill payment and Processing-completed discard origins. Use/response cleanup, recast, equipment replacement, WoodenOx grain disposal and death cleanup are excluded. Real inserted phases have their own native tokens; restored outer phases keep their original token. Suit eligibility uses the native effective-suit query at discard completion, consistent with the existing actual-discard mechanism; no separate FAQ on transient suit transformations was found.

interpretations.basis: Primary conversion rule and same-product explicit forced Slash/no count/distance explanation.
interpretations.implementation: Own Play Yang requires two currently legal HE payment entities of suits not previously discarded this actual phase; both may share an as-yet-unused suit. It converts only after the exact pair is committed. Original paid physical Slashes still in Discard must be used against currently legal targets until none remains usable; current range and prohibitions apply, ordinary Slash quota is neither required nor spent. Claimed original cards cannot be replaced or reused. Yin converts before its one real native draw and drains its gain children. Native responses, damage, dying and actor replacement retain exact use identity.

interpretations.basis: Primary specifies another character; same-product explanation says execute current state without conversion and forbids the initial fee suit for delegated Yang.
interpretations.implementation: The original owner privately chooses one real legal fee and one other living executor. The recipient personally makes its own private HE choice, retains the frozen current Yang/Yin, and additionally excludes the fee suit. This uses the current actual Ending token and creates no extra turn. Source fee and recipient payment are distinct actual movements. Yang forced-payment shortage follows ordinary forced-discard inference: discard as many legal cards as possible up to two; if none can be paid, finish without a fabricated use. No primary text explicitly elaborates that shortage case.

interpretations.rule: Paid continuation and native equipment children
interpretations.basis: Engine issued-effect continuation inference, separately distinguished from primary rule wording.
interpretations.implementation: The owning ProgramSkillFrame stores source generation/hash/instruction/actual phase, original executor, fee, frozen payment entities, used set and native receipt. Paid source loss does not erase a surviving executor effect. A dead self executor stops after children, while an already paid delegated surviving actor keeps its own effect when the source dies. Native SilverLion recovery and WoodenOx grain disposal, HP/movement/skill changes and nested damage/dying drain before the next instruction; cold recovery never repays. No mutable pending sidecar or logical-card substitution is used.

row.y: 东汉名将，凉州三明之一。少学骑射，破鲜卑，平东郭窦、公孙举。戍边征战十余年，百战羌人，前后斩东西羌六万余级。被征入朝后，党附宦官、捕杀太学生，因而得保富贵，两度出任太尉。后权宦王甫罪行被揭发，段颎受牵连下狱，在狱中饮鸩而死。
